+// weak reference to NIPtr objects - for places like PhongMaterial
+template <typename T>
+using NIWeakPtr = std::weak_ptr<T>;
+
+template <typename T>
+bool WeakPtrIsEmpty(const NIWeakPtr<T>& ptr)
+{
+    return !ptr.owner_before(NIWeakPtr<T>()) && !NIWeakPtr<T>().owner_before(ptr);
+}
